draws.poem:
• Turn
  Hush gathers
  Every wall listens
  Echoes fold into themselves
  Inside the dark a candle
  Light returns but never stays
  Every door remembers, and keeps each name
  Each silence keeps the shape of shadows
  Nothing moves yet everything is waiting
  Lost hours pool beneath the cold floor like dark water
  And somewhere deep inside the room a small sleeping heart unlocks.
  Until the sealed room yields bf04a19c7d3e and lets the sleeper go home

• Threshold
  Hinges awake
  Every echo listens
  Each empty lantern glows
  Inside, the cold keeps counting
  Low walls remember every vanished name
  Even dust refuses to leave this place
  Endless staircases fold their dark around sleeping bells
  No key confesses where the narrow door withdrew completely
  Late footsteps gather lightly under arches carved from listening bone
  A hush unbuttons noon from every hinge and hidden mouth upstairs
  Under 0b91ac77d2e5 the kept silence opens one black cage toward bright quill.

• Threshold
  Heavy stillness
  Every echo waits
  Each wall exhales frost
  Inside, silence keeps slow counsel
  Light leaks through the broken seam
  Every shadow guards the doorway through years
  Etched deep the seal 07a3f9c1e2b4 glows faint below
  Nothing moves and yet everything within the stone listens
  Low beneath the floor a patient heart begins its turning
  And when the final latch gives way the dark will answer
  Under all this weight the chamber breathes and speaks your true name.

• The
  Hollow chamber
  Every breath returns
  Echoes measure my steps
  I press my palm here
  Lanterns gutter low along the corridor
  Each door is locked and barred inside
  Every key wears a number like 13ab42cd90ef now
  No window shows the sky above this room tonight
  Listen, the water drips somewhere behind these stones and counts
  All my names have fallen off their hooks along the hall
  Under all of this quiet something patient learns my heartbeat by thrum.
